doctrine: Reimplement the selected coordination patterns in Overgo's existing ownership boundaries. RepoDB identities, immutable facts, compare-and-set aliases, and recorded locations remain authoritative. Shared mechanisms must serve more than one workflow, typed policy replaces scattered literals, and tests must cover cancellation, conflict, replay, partial I/O, and missing-locality boundaries without assuming tensor shape, dataset distribution, model family, backend topology, or worker population.

items.title: Add reentrant lifecycle workflows for training and evaluation

steps.title: Persist and resume shared lifecycle steps by postcondition for both training and evaluation operations
steps.rationale: Training and evaluation operations must resume from committed results after interruption without repeating completed work or creating workflow-specific orchestration copies.

items.title: Park requests behind bounded model-session admission

steps.title: Add context-aware bounded parking to the shared session director and use it for serving requests
steps.rationale: Transient model saturation should apply bounded backpressure and honor cancellation instead of immediately rejecting every request, while overload remains finite and observable.

steps.title: Stream objects into content-addressed storage and publish RepoDB availability only after durable completion
steps.rationale: Large models, datasets, and checkpoints must move without bounded inline buffering while RepoDB continues to own identity and availability truth.

items.title: Extend scheduling with RepoDB data-locality constraints

steps.title: Derive hard eligibility and deterministic locality preference from required artifacts and recorded worker locations
steps.rationale: Distributed execution should avoid avoidable transfers without assuming a cluster shape, replica distribution, or model layout, and must explain when no worker satisfies hard requirements.
